title: Dog use, seat graphics and interior comfort
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around dog-related practicality, seat and screen references, and broad uses of the word "huge," so the evidence does not support a single coherent theme.

positive.summary: Positive feedback mentions a desired remote climate-related capability that would help when leaving a dog in the car.

negative.summary: Negative feedback criticizes the seat-heating screen graphics as awkward and poorly designed.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention dog suitability, boot size, comfort, and general "huge step up" comments, but the short excerpts do not reliably establish clear sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects rather than one clear product issue or feature area.
Most fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the sentiment evidence is limited.
Several excerpts are very short, which makes the underlying sentiment and context unclear.
